title: Xolby's Home
description: A small plugin for home commands.
body:
**_Xolby's Home_**
A lightweight and easy-to-use **/home system** for your Minecraft server!
Players can set, teleport to, and delete their homes quickly with simple commands.

Commands
- /sethome – Set your personal home location
- /home – Teleport back to your home instantly
- /delhome – Delete your current home

Features
- Fully configurable messages

Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.18+ (Spigot / Paper / Purpur)
